issue.title: Passive neighbor peering does not come up when configured via BGPPeerPassive config in minigraph

failure.body:
---------------------------------------------------
BUG REPORT INFORMATION
---------------------------------------------------
Passive(Dynamic) BGP neighbors, when configured via BGPPeerPassive elements in the minigraph, do not lead to the addition of these passive peers to the actual BGP config.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Create BGPPeerPassive as below in the minigraph:
```
          <BGPPeer i:type="a:BGPPeerPassive">
            <ElementType>BGPPeer</ElementType>
            <Address><IP></Address>
            <RouteMapIn i:nil="true"/>
            <RouteMapOut i:nil="true"/>
            <Vrf i:nil="true"/>
            <a:Name>TestDynamic </a:Name>
            <a:PeersRange><IP>/21</a:PeersRange>
```
2. Run 'config load_minigraph'
3. Dump BGP config via 'show runningconfiguration bgp'

**Describe the results you received:**
No TestDynamic passive(dynamic) neighbors show in the runningconfiguration of BGP, showing us that it did not get configured. This results in failure to establish the peering with these neighbors

**Describe the results you expected:**
I expected to see:
```
neighbor TestDynamic peer-group
neighbor TestDynamic  passive
bgp listen range <IP>/21 peer-group TestDynamic
```

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**
Issue was observed on latest 20191130. The issue appears to be related to bgpcfgd expecting DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA config_db entries for the passive(dynamic) neighbors, and DEVICE_NEIGHBOR_METADATA should not be necessary for passive BGP sessions.

resolution.title: [bgpcfgd] Add fix to not require NEIGHBOR_METADATA entries for dynamic peers
resolution.description:
**- Why I did it**
Fix for https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4972
This fix removes the requirement to have a NEIGHBOR_METADATA for dynamic peers. The change is made since it is not necessary for NEIGHBOR_METADATA entries be present for the dynamic neighbors

**- How I did it**
Changed bgpcfgd to limit checks for neigh_meta to dynamic peers

**- How to verify it**
Verified on DUT by creating a dynamic peer without NEIGHBOR_METADATA entries and ensure that bgpcfgd allows the creation of this dynamic peer in the FRR BGP config.
